infrastructure_only_attempts.reason: regional SSD quota while creating later nodes; launcher stopped and deleted the nodes already created
L4 stockout in us-east4; launcher stopped and deleted the three nodes already created

decision.selected_topology: two single-L4 nodes in nearby regions
decision.reason: The two-node topology was about 1.9 times faster per optimizer step than the geographically dispersed four-node topology at the same effective batch size.
decision.next_gate: Run the registered 20-step smoke and require finite post-warmup gradient norms, finite loss, exact checkpoint state, and a healthy adapter before the first 500-step stage.

notes: The two compatibility steps both occurred at zero reported learning rate during warmup and reported NaN gradient norm, so they are insufficient as the numerical-stability gate.
Historical EXP004 logs using the same optimizer show finite gradient norms after warmup.
All VMs from every attempt were terminated and deleted after artifacts or failure evidence were preserved.
